data.name: Desert Struggle
data.detailed_description:
Gameplay

At first glance, the battlefield may feel familiar: gather resources, construct buildings, and produce units. But once deployed, your forces act on their own. Workers harvest, scouts explore, and combat units attack the enemy. There is no micromanagement of individual troops. Instead, every decision before a unit leaves the factory becomes critical.

Which units should you produce? When should production begin? Do you invest in another facility, upgrades, expand or produce units now? Can you anticipate your opponent's next wave and prepare the right counter in time?

Work in Progress

This game is work in progress. While it is technically in a stable state, not all content is available yet.

Completed:

- 1st faction with 13 units, 14 buildings, 25 upgrades

- Ranked online PvP (1v1) with automatic matchmaking

- Custom online PvP (1v1)

- 4 maps

- 40 single player challenges on 1v1 maps vs AI opponents

- Custom single player matches vs AI-Bots

- Replays (without save)

In progress:

- Single player campaign

- Map editor

- 2nd faction

Planned:

- 3rd faction

- more game modes

- store replays in DB

- online match history

- ...

data.short_description: Desert Struggle is a fast paced real time strategy game. It is about base building, production timing and attack waves. Units are fully automated, so there are no standing armies. It is all about production capacities, expansions and timings! Play challenges against the AI or online in PvP matches.
